# Floating rate note (`frn` v1)

Coupon resets over an RFR or term rate.

**Asset class:** Fixed income · **Family:** bond · **Product type:** `FRN` · **Exchange-traded**

Applies to trades whose `productType` is `FRN`. Open one with `TRD <tradeId>`.

```sutra
sutra: frn
version: 1
description: Coupon resets over an RFR or term rate.
match: { kind: trade, where: "$.productType == 'FRN'", priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Fixed income · Floating rate note, id: $.tradeId, with: "link($.counterparty.id, 'counterparty', $.counterparty.name)" }
strip:
  - { label: Notional, bind: "$.currency + ' ' + fmt($.notional, 'amount0')" }
  - { label: Direction, bind: $.direction }
  - { label: Trade date, bind: $.tradeDate, fmt: date }
  - { label: Maturity, bind: $.maturityDate, fmt: date }
  - { label: MTM (USD), bind: $.mtm, fmt: signed0, tone: sign, emphasis: true }
  - { label: CS01 (USD), bind: $.risk.cs01, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { label: DV01 (USD), bind: $.risk.dv01, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { label: Status, bind: $.status, tone: status }
panels:
  - id: terms
    kind: kv
    title: Terms
    code: TRM
    key: F2
    columns:
      - { label: Quoted margin, bind: $.terms.quotedMargin, fmt: bp1 }
      - { label: Face amount, bind: $.terms.faceAmount, fmt: amount0 }
      - { label: Clean price, bind: $.terms.cleanPrice, fmt: price2 }
      - { label: Effective, bind: $.effectiveDate, fmt: date }
      - { label: Counterparty, bind: $.counterparty.name }
  - id: schedule
    kind: ladder
    title: Coupons
    code: CPN
    key: F3
    rows: $.schedule
    highlight: "#index == $.nextIndex"
    columns:
      - { label: Date, bind: "@.date", fmt: date }
      - { label: Coupon, bind: "@.rate", fmt: pct4 }
      - { label: Amount, bind: "@.amount", fmt: amount0, total: true }
      - { label: Status, bind: "@.status", tone: status }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - id: marketData
    kind: line
    title: "Interest rate curve: Zero rates (%)"
    code: CRV
    key: F4
    area: right
    source: "link($.forwardCurve, 'ir-curve')"
    rows: points
    x: tenor
    y: zeroRate
    fmt: price2
  - id: sensitivities
    kind: hbar
    title: CS01 by bucket (USD)
    code: SENS
    area: right
    rows: $.sensitivities
    label: bucket
    value: cs01
    fmt: signed0
    tone: sign
  - id: pnl
    kind: line
    title: Daily P&L, last 20 days (USD)
    code: PNL
    area: right
    rows: $.pnlHistory
    x: date
    y: pnl
    fmt: signed0
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.nettingSet, 'netting-set')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```

## Terms

Product-specific terms live under `terms` in the trade document.

| Field | Label | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `terms.quotedMargin` | Quoted margin | `bp1` |
| `terms.faceAmount` | Face amount | `amount0` |
| `terms.cleanPrice` | Clean price | `price2` |

## Market data

Reference fields on the trade point at the market data it is valued with. They show under *Linked entities* and drive F8 impact ("which trades use this curve?").

| Field | Kind | Selected by |
|---|---|---|
| `forwardCurve` | `ir-curve` (Interest rate curve) | `proj:{ccy}` |
| `underlyingBond` | `bond` (Bond (security master)) | `{bond}` |
| `creditCurve` | `credit-curve` (Credit curve) | `{issuer}` |

## Risk

| Measure | Field | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| CS01 | `risk.cs01` | value change for a 1 bp widening of credit spreads |
| DV01 | `risk.dv01` | value change for a 1 bp parallel fall in rates |

The *CS01 by bucket* chart reads `sensitivities[].cs01`.

## Coupons

`schedule` rows (ladder), F3: `date`, `rate`, `amount`, `status`. The next event is highlighted (`nextIndex`).

## Layout notes

- The strip leads with size and dates, then MTM (emphasised) and the product's main risk measures.
- F2 is the terms, F3 the schedule, F4 the market data it is most sensitive to; F7 opens the netting set, F8 shows impact and F9 the raw document.
- Common fields (counterparty, netting set, book, trader, MTM, P&L) are described in the pack guide.
